name: Ticino pharma quality and regulatory specialist

context.occupation: Pharmaceutical quality assurance / regulatory affairs specialist
context.geography: Lives in Ticino; selectively considers Switzerland and northern Italy
context.employment_state: Employed, selective rather than urgent search
constraints: Exclude laboratory research and production-operator roles
Italian and English search; working-language requirements checked separately
context.company_awareness: Selective employer list across the region; open to a few additional relevant companies

trigger: Checks a known employer's vacancy but finds broad pharma searches mixing laboratory, production, cosmetics and regulatory roles without clear workload or travel requirements.

searches_run.query: quality assurance regulatory affairs farmaceutico Ticino lavoro
searches_run.observation: Retrieval included Lugano pharma regulatory work, a Balerna cosmetics QA/regulatory role and an Italian locality named Santo Stefano Ticino. Direct inspections confirmed materially different sectors and duties despite overlapping titles.

searches_run.query: quality assurance regulatory affairs Ticino 80 100 limited travel
searches_run.observation: Results mixed older Lugano listings, Switzerland-wide aggregations, medtech and non-pharma jobs. No inspected source established all of pharma scope, 80–100% flexibility and limited travel together. An inspected pharma role states full time; the cosmetics role states unspecified part-time and supplier audits.

sources.title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist — Orienta Lugano
sources.supports: Direct agency-source inspection states pharma regulatory dossiers, permanent full-time Monday–Friday work, English required and German optional. Exact employer, 80% availability and travel frequency are not stated.

sources.title: Regulatory Affairs & Quality Assurance Specialist — SV Laboratoires
sources.supports: Direct employer page concerns cosmetics in Balerna, Italian/English fluency, unspecified part-time work and supplier/lab audits. It also contains conflicting no-open-positions text, leaving availability unresolved; not a confirmed pharma match.

sources.title: Quality Assurance Farmaceutico Santo Stefano Ticino — Indeed
sources.supports: Retrieved locality is in Lombardy, not Swiss Ticino; relevant to explicit geography selection rather than automatic rejection of northern Italy.

sources.title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist search — Frontaliere Ticino
sources.supports: Retrieved page mixes Swiss locations and unrelated quality/regulatory contexts. Its legal, tax, refresh and eligibility claims were not adopted or verified.

best_entry_page.primary_query: quality assurance regulatory affairs farmaceutico Ticino
best_entry_page.promise: Map covered regional pharmaceutical employers and distinguish QA/regulatory roles from laboratory, production and adjacent-sector jobs using source responsibilities.
best_entry_page.cta: Verificare gli employer e confrontare i requisiti
proof_needed: Verified pharmaceutical employer and site coverage
Clear Swiss Ticino versus northern-Italy geography
QA, regulatory, QC lab and production duties distinguished
Workload percentage quoted only where explicit
Travel frequency unknown unless stated; audits do not quantify travel
Resolve conflicting source availability before showing live roles
New indexable guide; company/search pages are noindex

conversion_objections: Are these pharma roles or cosmetics, medical devices and generic quality jobs?
Does 80–100% mean 80% is available for this exact position?
How often would supplier audits require travel?
Can I follow my own selected employers?
Does the Italian page still require another working language?
Is the location the plant, headquarters or a similarly named Italian town?

avoid_targeting.reason: Different function from the targeted QA/regulatory work.
Absence of travel wording cannot establish no travel.
Cross-border legal/tax advice is outside the product and this assignment.
QA abbreviation describes a different occupation.

message_to_founder: Simulation: Conosco già alcune aziende e posso aspettare il ruolo giusto. Aiutatemi a distinguere qualità e regolatorio farmaceutico dalle altre funzioni, indicando chiaramente percentuale d'impiego e trasferte quando sono davvero specificate.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic persona, exactly two searches and two direct inspections. Other rows are hypotheses. No residence/citizenship/work-permit inference, regulatory advice or tax guidance. Current vacancy availability, workload flexibility and travel remain partly unknown. Italian interface/posting language is not proof of workplace-language eligibility. Selective employer monitoring fits after coverage validation.
